name: a_stock_answer_format
description: Format verified A-share tool payloads into a concise Chinese answer. Use only for evidence already returned by A-share lookup tools; do not fetch new facts or infer unsupported investment conclusions. Preserve source/time evidence and include a short non-personalized investment-advice boundary.

user_message.description: Original user request. Preserve company names, symbols, relative-date hints, requested fields, source constraints, and freshness requirements verbatim.

answer_kind.description: Expected answer format for the already verified A-share payload.

payload.description: Exact payload returned by an A-share lookup tool. Preserve its top-level tool and readiness contract; do not reconstruct or add unsupported facts.

tool.description: Original A-share lookup tool identity from the verified payload.

readiness.description: Original readiness contract from the verified payload. Do not omit it when relaying the payload.

answer_ready.description: Whether the source lookup marked the evidence ready for an answer.
